name: Browning-Ferris Industries of Vermont, Inc. v. Kelco Disposal, Inc.
summary: The Court held that the Excessive Fines Clause does not apply to punitive damages awarded in civil cases between private parties, but analyzed the clause's history and its application to government-imposed fines.
significance: This case examined the historical roots and scope of the Excessive Fines Clause, helping define what types of government-imposed monetary penalties are covered by the Eighth Amendment.
